correctness.rationale: Integrating the Erlang survival function against exp(iωt) and dividing by the mean waiting time gives F_n=((1-iz)^(-n)-1)/(inz), with F_n(0)=1. The energy basis makes P−O a sum over unordered pairs weighted by 2|rho_0,jk|². With y=z², W=(1+y)^n, and A+i z B=(1+i z)^n, the direct numerator of |F_n|²−Re F_n over n²yW² is yB²+(W−A)²−nyBW. Exact division by y²W reproduces Q_n. An independent rational Sturm check gave matched sign variations at 0 and +infinity for n=2,…,13 (0,0,1,1,2,2,3,3,3,4,4,4 on each end) and Q_n(0)>0 for every one, so none has a nonnegative zero. It also checks Q_1=0 and reproduces the exact n=14 balanced-qubit value −40308117/105226698752. Only nonzero-gap coherences can contribute for shapes 2–13, so the equality condition is precisely [H,rho_0]=0 including degeneracies.
residual_risks: The result is about equilibrium renewal ages and Hilbert–Schmidt overlap for mixed reset states; it does not assert convergence from arbitrary age initialization or address noninteger shapes.
